title: Direct application receipt
description: Direct cherry-pick application record, attached to the applied commit (shared-portable note record; src/operations.js cherryPick).

appliedCommit.description: The commit this record is attached to; when the record carries attachedTo, both must be equal.

relation.description: How the applied change relates to its origin. The CLI writes 'same-logical-change' or 'derived-fork'; the value is an open string.
